name: Happy + Hale
area: Ninth Street or University Hill, Durham
order: Med Bowl with herb-roasted chicken, rice, greens, cucumber and tomato, or Thai Chicken Crunch for a different flavor.
tip: Ask for dressing and crunchy toppings separately if saving a portion for lunch. These two bowls do not list beans, but other bowls do.

name: Alpaca
area: Ninth Street or South Square, Durham
order: Rotisserie chicken with plain rice and house salad. A whole-chicken combo can cover dinner and a next-day lunch.
tip: Choose vegetable sides alongside the rice, skip bean-based sides if preferred, and keep sauces separate. Check the current location menu for side availability.

name: CAVA
order: Build a chicken bowl with rice, greens, cucumber, tomato and tzatziki.
tip: Hummus and falafel are chickpea-based. Leave them out when choosing a meal without beans or chickpeas, and keep extra dressing on the side.

name: Chipotle
order: Chicken, rice, fajita vegetables, fresh tomato salsa and lettuce, without beans.
tip: Add vegetables rather than relying on rice alone for the base. Pack cold toppings separately from anything you plan to reheat.

name: Guasaca
area: Erwin Square, 2200 West Main Street, Durham
order: Build a chicken bowl with rice and available vegetable toppings, without beans.
tip: A useful change from Mediterranean bowls. Confirm current toppings and substitutions on the restaurant menu.

name: Mediterranean Grill & Grocery
order: Chicken kabob platter over Greek salad, with pita, baba ghanouj and stuffed grape leaves.
tip: The platter offers a rice or Greek-salad base and two sides. The salad base adds vegetables, while pita and rice-filled grape leaves supply starch. Hummus and falafel contain chickpeas.

name: Namu
order: Look for a rice-and-vegetable bowl with Korean BBQ protein, such as bibimbap if available, with sauce separately.
tip: Choose a vegetable-forward bowl rather than a fries-based dish. This is a suggested order, not a confirmed current menu item. Check the ordering menu for ingredients and substitutions.
